subject.title: refactor: make Telegram release workflow tests behavioral

question: After resolving conflicts with current main, does the resulting workflow still check out and execute the advisory-status helper only after trusted identity verification, with the intended status and provenance behavior preserved?
rationale: The proposed code is in a release workflow security boundary, but the current branch cannot merge cleanly; conflict resolution can change the security-relevant execution ordering and needs maintainer review of the actual merge result.

options.title: Reconcile and re-review the merge result
options.body: Resolve the branch against current main, rerun the focused behavioral checks, and verify the trusted checkout remains after identity verification.

options.title: Pause the refactor
options.body: Leave the inline implementation in place if preserving and revalidating the workflow trust boundary is not worth the current merge churn.

recommendation.title: Reconcile and re-review the merge result
recommendation.body: Resolve the branch against current main, rerun the focused behavioral checks, and verify the trusted checkout remains after identity verification.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the exact workflow and helper changes and can reconcile the branch while preserving the stated boundary.
